nom: IUNIK Beta-Glucan Power Moisture Serum - Deep Hydration 1.69 fl oz

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry, dehydrated, or flaky skin, including some with a compromised skin barrier, widely report noticeably softer, plumper, more hydrated skin, in some cases within just a couple of nights.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including one oily in the T-zone and dry elsewhere, report it layers well without adding shine and helps balance drier areas, especially in winter.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive or rosacea-prone skin repeatedly describe it as one of the few serums that doesn't sting, redden, or irritate their skin, even under prescription rosacea medication.
segments.normal: One reviewer who describes her skin as normal and not usually sensitive had a severe allergic reaction with hives across her face and neck.
segments.mature: A reviewer in her early 50s and another in her late 60s both report tighter, more hydrated, glowing skin with regular use.

concerns.aging: One reviewer in her early 40s using it as a moisture booster didn't notice real anti-aging results from this serum specifically, while another in her late 60s, using it alongside other treatments, reported her skin looked tighter and more glowing after six weeks.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers, including several with dry, dehydrated, or compromised-barrier skin, report noticeably softer, plumper, more hydrated skin within days; a couple, however, say it left their skin dry or that they saw no real difference compared to a hyaluronic acid serum they already used.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers, including some with rosacea or dermatitis, report the serum calms redness and irritation without the stinging they get from other serums; one reviewer, however, broke out in hives across her face and neck, despite normally not having sensitive skin.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers specifically bought this for a weakened or compromised skin barrier and report it helped with moisture retention and repair, recommending it mainly for those with a distressed barrier rather than for basic hydration.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers with acne-prone or blemish-prone skin report no new breakouts and some describe fewer clogged pores or blemishes; one reviewer, however, broke out in small bumps after combining it with an azelaic acid serum.
concerns.oiliness: A couple of reviewers note it doesn't add shine or greasiness, with one specifically using it only when her combination skin feels less oily than usual.

aspects.libelle: Lightweight texture that absorbs without stickiness
Dropper doesn't dispense the thick serum well
Packaging changed from glass to plastic for Amazon
Small bottle lasts a long time

extraits.texte: I had a severe allergic reaction using this product. I have hives all over my face and neck should’ve known it was too good to be true with the price. I have normal skin that is not usually sensitive.

It broke me out. I have acne prone skin. My skin was doing good with Anua Azeliac acid serum, but when I combined this serum, I got a bunch of little bumps. It locks in moisture but my skin didn’t like it.

extraits.titre: No Fuss Moisture Retention / On My Third Bottle
extraits.texte: I am on my third bottle of the Beta-Glucan Power Moisture Serum because I love it that much. While I'm not prone to breakouts, I have sensitive, combination skin where I'm oily in my T Zone and dry everywhere else and also have rosacea. This serum has never agitated my skin and seems to really help with my moisture retention. I use it twice a day have a very minimal skincare routine consisting of toner, this product, and sunscreen in the morning or moisturizer at night. I love how lightweight it goes on and doesn't leave my skin feeling tacky, plus it plays well with other products. It's a small bottle but it lasts about 3 months using it twice per day so I feel like it's pretty cost effective compared to other serums. This is a very no fuss product if you're someone looking to heal or maintain your skin barrier and improve moisture retention!

extraits.titre: Must have if you have rosacea and sensitive reactive skin!!!
extraits.texte: I have sensitive reactive skin with rosacea. This is the only serum that does not burn, irate my skin. Most serums make my face red the minute I use them. It is a drink of water that hydrates and makes my face feel so good. It does not cause redness or any irritation I use this morning and night. I can not use any actives and this is my favorite product. I am 52 years old and everyone does not believe it and I always asked what I use. This may be my favorite skin care product ever. I can not live without this serum. The results are amazing skin is soft, glowy, and plump. Perfect under makeup.

This serum is a game changer! I suffer from dry, rosacea, acne-prone skin and had two estheticians tell me that my skin was “dehydrated” because my skin doesn’t retain moisture. I was recommended this product and was skeptical at first because of some of the reviews. Let me clear some things up, it has no smell whatsoever, and it goes on so light and smooth and does not feel gooey or sticky. I put it on after I use toner and then I put on my moisturizer after. In just a few days I already noticed that my normally dry and flaky skin actually looked like it had life! My skin looks dewy (but not greasy) and I can’t see any dry spots. I absolutely recommend this product to anyone who has dry skin because it’s so gentle that it doesn’t irritate my rosacea or cause any new breakouts.

extraits.titre: Good for weak skin barrier and dehydrated/very dry skin
extraits.texte: My purchase was carefully packed, so no issues there. It also had 2 authentication stickers on it. One seal has a hologram on it. You download a program, then you scan the code on the seal to verify authenticity. This is very hydrating. I could tell a difference the morning after I first applied. It would be better if used with the lotion, probably. It's very thick but absorbs quickly. Do you need this? I would only get this if you have a weakened or distressed skin barrier. If you just need something for moisture, hyaluronic acid will do the job. Unless you have severely dry skin, you may not even need a serum because so many products have hyaluronic acid these days. I purchased this because I have a compromised skin barrier and my skin is very dehydrated this winter.

Hi, I’ve been using this serum for at least 6 weeks. I saw my skin getting tighter, hydrated and glowing. It’s the only thing I added to my routine. Red laser, nuface, Dr Pen but this seems to enhance everything. Ref: late 60’s
